🎬 Flashback: Axios House at Climate Week & UNGA 2025

Axios co-founder Mike Allen and White House National Energy Dominance Council executive director Jarrod Agen on stage at Axios House Climate Week and UNGA. Photo: Sam Popp for Axios

Catch up quick: Last year, Axios House convened over 1300 industry leaders for newsworthy conversations on shaping the global agenda and influencing climate action. 

  • Featured speakers included Gap Inc. chief communications officer Mame Annan-Brown, Ecolab chairman and CEO Christophe Beck, Delta Air Lines chief sustainability officer Amelia DeLuca, Patagonia CEO Ryan Gellert, Amazon chief sustainability officer Kara Hurst, TerraPower president and CEO Chris Levesque, Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D-N.H.), Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse (D-R.I.), McLaren Racing director of sustainability Kim Wilson and many more.
